record_audits.database_subject: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (61.54%) to Temporin-1SPb L: 38%, I=S: 15%. Activity: active against S. aureus USA300 LAC and 5 clinical strains (MIC 1-2 uM), S. epidermidis 1457 (MIC 1 uM), E-coli E423-17 (MIC > 16 uM), A-baumannii B28-16 (MIC >16 uM), P-aeruginosa E411-17 (MIC > 16 uM), and K-pneumoniae E406-17 (MIC > 16 uM). Also, disrupted biofilms:bacteria:S. aureus (24 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC HC50 150 uM, less hemo.lytic. Antimicrobial robustness: pH-sensitive (acidic pH 5.5), NaCl-insensitive:S. aureus (100 mM), serum-sensitive (10%, MIC increased 4-8 fold). MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: permeated bacterial membranes. Updated Jan2026
